30% of library images have unclear usage rights (freelancer shoots, no signed release). Owner: Sofia. No deadline set.

Two partners use our logo on their sites without approved lockup. Reputational, low. Owner: partnerships (unnamed).

Primary brand colour pair fails contrast on text (3.1:1). Affects web and decks. Owner: Tom + dev team. Target: Q1.

14 deck templates on shared drive, 3 official. Owner: ops. Cleanup 'before year end'.
